entries.en: Your mouth runs on a 24-hour clock.

Bacteria, saliva and acids each keep their own hours. 

What it needs at 07:00 is not what it needs at 22:00.
Cortisol rises; coffee, breakfast and the day's first acids follow. Enamel needs its shield on first.

entries.en: Trusted by professionals who look beyond the teeth

The best outcome is the one prevented. These practitioners recommend Karmicare between visits. Not to replace their care, but to make the twelve hundred brushings a year between appointments count for something.
Dental Hygienist, Oral Care Quality Manager

“Karmicare offers fluoride-free oral care in a thoughtful way, with hydroxyapatite as a scientifically supported choice. By also taking biorhythm into account, the brand touches on the foundations on which true health is built. This vision aligns seamlessly with my professional conviction that only an integrated approach, bringing together science, biology, rhythm and nature, leads to lasting health.”

entries.en:
“As a nutritional therapist specialized in female hormones, I’m extremely careful about what I put into my body. Hormones are sensitive. Stress, toxins, poor-quality ingredients — they all add up. So I don’t just look at labels, I look at what something will do inside the body.

I choose Karmicare because I trust what’s in it — and what’s not. No unnecessary fillers, no hidden disruptors. Just clean, purposeful ingredients that support rather than burden the nervous system and hormonal balance. When you understand how delicate the female endocrine system can be, especially under chronic stress, quality isn’t optional.

And that’s also why I use it in my practice.

I work with women dealing with PMS, cycle issues, stress-related fatigue, estrogen dominance and adrenal dysregulation. I need products that are technically sound — bioavailable, well-formulated, and supportive of detox pathways and nervous system regulation.

Karmicare fits that standard.”

entries.en: Everything people usually ask before switching to a day-and-night oral care system.
Why two formulas instead of one?

Because your mouth doesn’t do the same job all day. Daytime is exposure — acids, sugars, coffee — so Awake protects, activates and brightens. Night is repair — saliva drops and your body regenerates — so Asleep soothes, rebalances and remineralises while you sleep.

entries.en: How quickly will I notice a difference?

Mineral remineralisation takes time — most members feel the sensitivity shift in 2–4 weeks and see visible brightening in 4–6. The ritual shift happens faster: you notice the bookend effect within the first week — a morning moment that wakes you up, an evening moment that winds you down.

Care Credit is Karmicare credit: spend it on more care, never on your dental bill. It rewards the visit, not the verdict. Not insurance, and not a payment towards treatment.
Two minutes, morning and night. Your membership returns Care Credit: 10% of every 60-Day Rhythm, 20% of the Year.
On the Year, a check-up after month six adds €40 in Care Credit, once per membership year. You walk in with something to gain, not only something to pay.
Spend Care Credit on any order. It stays valid while you are a member, and for 12 months after.
